name: Illusions Of Darkness
source:
Illusions of Darkness - is a visual novel in the psychological horror genre, created primarily with the help of artificial intelligence.

The story tells about three young people - Emily, Jake and the player, who came to the forest at night to visit an old, abandoned sanatorium. The plot holds secrets that will be revealed as the game progresses.

[From [url=https://xorti.itch.io/illusions-of-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黑暗幻象 - 是一部心理恐怖类型的视觉小说，主要在人工智能的帮助下创作。

故事讲述了三个年轻人——艾米丽、杰克和玩家，他们在夜晚来到森林，参观一座古老的、废弃的疗养院。剧情中隐藏着一些秘密，这些秘密将随着游戏的进展而揭晓。

[来自[url=https://xorti.itch.io/illusions-of-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
